summary: Percent-encode helper emits lowercase hex, which violates the uppercase convention and breaks the PR's own expected params output.

findings.explanation: PERCENT formats with `:02x` (lowercase), while the removed helper uppercased. `params={"u": "http://example.com?q=foo%2Fa"}` now yields `http%3a%2f%2f...` but the added test expects `http%3A%2F%2F...`. Non-ASCII characters and normalization/equality comparisons are also affected (RFC 3986 prefers uppercase).
